integrity.method: Exact factorial-moment and cherry-count recurrences plus independently implemented rational dynamic programming and exhaustive coalescent histories up to eight leaves

scientific_limitations: Valid only for the standard binary neutral Kingman coalescent with each unordered lineage pair coalescing at rate one.
An alternative time normalization scales the covariance in the same proportion.
No claim of a full joint distribution, model universality, or historical priority certification.
The separate asymptotic variance statements are drawn from cited primary literature; the exact mixed covariance is proved here.
title: An order-independent cherry–external-length covariance in Kingman's coalescent
